correctness.rationale: For uniform Y on [-1,1]^d and metric ell_infinity, the continuous L2 affine projector has coefficients a_i=3E[Y_i f(Y)]=3/2 E[(1-Y_i^2)partial_i f(Y)] by exact slice integration by parts. Affine ell_infinity Lipschitz seminorm equals sum|a_i|, while the gradient ell_1 norm is <=1 a.e. Thus upper A_d<=3/2(1-E[min_i|Y_i|^2])=3/2(1-2/((d+1)(d+2))), strictly <3/2 for finite d. Median on any k=2m+1 coordinates is 1-Lipschitz, has beta(m+1,m+1) middle order statistic, E[median^2]=1/(k+2), proving lower 3/2(1-1/(k+2)), k=d odd or d-1 even. Both bounds converge to 3/2, proving the sharp dimension-free constant and A3>=6/5. Independently checked rational integral and median moments for dimensions 1,2,3,4,5,10,20,30. Exact A_d for all finite d NOT claimed.
